messages:
kai: Quick follow-up idea: design a HSM-backed encrypted-shard warmup flow for public streams + private buckets. Goal: zero-trust streaming where decrypt keys never leave KMS/HSM and loader still achieves low-latency warmup. Thoughts?
alyssa: Interesting. How do you keep decrypt out of the critical path without pre-decrypting everything?
kai: Sketch: 1) shards are uploaded encrypted with envelope keys. 2) manifests carry per-shard envelope metadata + short per-chunk tweak (nonce/fingerprint). 3) Loader requests short-lived unwrap tokens from HSM for specific chunk ranges, uses those tokens to spawn decrypt workers that stream-decrypt into staged pinned pages. 4) Full attestation logs + async signature verification.
marie: HSM unwrap latency could be a killer at scale. We need batching for token unwrap and aggressive reuse windows but without widening attack surface.
ishaan: Proposal: introduce unwrap tokens scoped to manifest_epoch + stripe_range with tight TTL (eg 30s). Token issuance supports batched unwrap for N contiguous chunks. HSM policy logs every unwrap. If token revoked, loader must evict dependent pages.
ram: Tradeoff: mmap of encrypted file + decrypt-on-DMA vs staged decrypt into pinned slab. Which to prefer?
kai: For read-once big shards, mmap+on-the-fly decrypt (using user-space decryption during DMA) minimizes memory copy but needs kernel support for DMA decrypt. For many small hot chunks, staged pinned decrypt yields lower tail latency. We'll expose decrypt_hint: mmap|staged in shard metadata.
alyssa: We also need a safe fallback for non-HSM environments (dev/local). Maybe a KMS-proxy that mints tokens using RBAC and records audit trails.
marie: Security: ensure manifest headers include a canonical merkle_root over encrypted chunks so we can cheaply fingerprint without decrypt, then verify post-decrypt signature. Also require attestation header from HSM for token issuance so we can tie unwraps to a specific loader instance.
ishaan: Add incremental verification: cheap per-chunk 64-bit tag stored outside encryption (header) so loader can reject corrupt ciphertext early. Full crypto-verify after decrypt is async and if it fails we tombstone chunk and increment verify_failures metric.
ram: How to handle hotpatching while tokens are live? If new manifest replaces epoch, we must refuse to accept older unwrap tokens for new epoch. Use epoch-bound tokens and CAS on manifest pointer.
kai: Exactly. Token includes epoch_id and chunk_range. Loader pins epoch when opening model and refuses to accept tokens for mismatched epoch. We keep previous epoch state for quick rollback if overlay fails verification.
alyssa: Perf numbers needed. HSM unwrap QPS and latency, extra round-trips for small chunks, memory overhead for staged decrypt. We should simulate worst-case: many small chunk unwraps per second.
marie: Operationally: feature-flagged rollout, start in dedicated private clusters (where we can run a local HSM simulator), then controlled beta for public streams. Add alert when unwrap_error_rate > 0.1% or when token-issuance-latency P95 > 200ms.
ishaan: POC tasks: implement token-batching API, add unwrap token cache with TTL + revocation watch, and a decrypt-worker pool tied to token lifetimes.
kai: Minimal header sketch (proto):
```
manifest_header {
  epoch_id: "e2026-03-01"
  merkle_root: "sha256:..."
  shards: [
    { id: "shard-000", enc_algo: "aes-gcm-256", envelope: {hsm_key_id: "hk-123"}, chunk_meta: [{offset:0, len:65536, tag: "u64:..."}, ...] }
  ]
}
```
ram: Nice. Add metrics: unwrap_token_requests, unwrap_token_cache_hits, decrypt_worker_utilization, decrypt_latency_p50/p95/p99, post_decrypt_verify_failures, epoch_mismatch_aborts.
alyssa: API ergonomics: ModelLoader.open_encrypted(manifest_ref, unwrap_policy) where unwrap_policy can be lazy|batched|eager. Lazy = unwrap on first access; batched = warmup requests batched per-range; eager = unwrap whole model (for strict low-latency).
ishaan: Testing: integrate with HSM simulator that supports high-latency mode and revocation to exercise rollback. Inject corrupted ciphertext and ensure async post-decrypt verification triggers eviction and alerting.
marie: Also document a customer migration path: how to produce envelope-encrypted shards from their build pipelines and recommended chunk sizes (large enough to amortize unwrap cost).
opsbot: CI: created job hsm-loader/proto-integration (queue 6).
kai: Action items: kai -> push hsm-proto branch w/ token cache + small simulator by Fri; ishaan -> implement post-decrypt verifier + perf harness by next Tue; ram -> add metrics + dashboards; alyssa -> write e2e tests for unwrap_policy modes; marie -> draft rollout runbook & customer docs.
marie: :thumbsup:
